headline: Cantor Fitzgerald Maintains Neutral on Arch Capital Group, Raises Price Target to $110
summary: Cantor Fitzgerald  analyst Ryan Tunis   maintains Arch Capital Group (NASDAQ:ACGL) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $102 to $110.
